claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_resistance.source_filter_all_damage
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing resistance surface only models resistance keyed by damage type. This item grants resistance to any damage that comes from attacks made with ranged weapons.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding this Shield, you have Resistance to damage from attacks made with Ranged weapons.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: redirect_attack_target
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The curse automatically intercepts a qualifying ranged-weapon attack aimed at a nearby creature and replaces that creature with the cursed bearer before attack resolution.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever an attack with a Ranged weapon targets a creature within 10 feet of you, the curse causes you to become the target instead.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic_item.attunement_curse
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The curse is acquired when you attune and persists even after the shield is removed, ending only via Remove Curse or similar magic. Current magic-item mechanics only model passive/activated behavior while the item is in play; they do not model a detached ongoing curse bestowed by attunement.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Attuning to it curses you until you are targeted by a Remove Curse spell or similar magic. Removing the Shield fails to end the curse on you.
